null_policy: Absent or unresolved Current semantics stay absent. Consumers must not synthesize missing medical relations, cues, locators or enrichment.
freshness_policy: Every referenced source is pinned by path + blob SHA. Any mismatch makes only dependent assets STALE pending targeted recompile.
content_copy_policy: Prefer refs/selectors over copied medical prose. Projection owns representation metadata, not canonical medical truth.

calibration_batch_01.goal: Prove multi-object, optional-enrichment, multi-source and multi-view expressivity before full A1/A2/A3 compilation.
runtime_blockers_outside_scope: Question attempts must become append-preserved / phase-aware before multi-pass question Runtime productization.
